entries.effect: the action of this annotation: its /A dictionary read through PDFAction's own factory, nil for an annotation that names none.  Three measured shapes - an /A with no /S answers nil (act-no-s), an /S the format does not list answers the BASE class with -type the name it carried (act-unknown-s, "Bogus"), and an /Named whose /N is outside the eight the host builds answers NO ACTION AT ALL.  And a BARE /Dest produces an action: the format's own rule that a /Dest without /A is a /GoTo to that destination, built through -initWithDestination: over the very object -destination answers, so the two are one object and not two reads of one array

entries.effect: the DESTINATION OF THE ACTION, and not the /Dest read on its own - which is the opposite of what the first version of this did.  ann-dest-and-a carries BOTH a /Dest whose /XYZ names (1, 2) with zoom 3 and an /A whose /D is a /Fit, and the host answers point UNSPECIFIED - the /A's - where a read of the /Dest would have answered 1, 2 and 3.  So this is one line over -action: the destination of a /GoTo, and nil for every other action.  A bare /Dest produces one because the synthesised GoTo carries it, and a NAMED /Dest answers a destination whose page is nil rather than no destination, while the DICTIONARY spelling of a /Dest answers nil for both members (ann-dest-dict)

entries.effect: the release's own substring search over each page's text - Foundation's -rangeOfString:options:range:, which is what the header's three options are - and one PDFSelection per occurrence, whose range is the match extended by ONE character when the character after it is a line break and by nothing else.  Measured over the 136 rows of the fixture family facts/PDFKit/Selection11.md describes: nothing is snapped ("al" is {5,2}, "pha" is {7,3}), no space is ever taken, a needle never spans a page, a case-insensitive match answers the DOCUMENT's spelling and not the needle's, NSBackwardsSearch reverses the answer and not the ranges, and a needle that is not there answers an EMPTY array.  The array it answers is the document's own and the next search on that document replaces its contents, which is measured and is why two searches of one document cannot be compared through one array

entries.effect: the search carried on from a selection, as PDFDocument.h:274 describes: "beginning after the last character of selection ... (or preceding the first character of the selection if NSBackwardsSearch is specified)".  A nil selection starts at the beginning of the document, or at its end when the search runs backwards - measured on a document nothing had been asked: {5,5} forward and {31,5} backwards.  The search CROSSES onto the next page, in the direction it runs, and answers nil off the end of the document; measured on cgfixture-3.pdf, forwards from page 1's "page" answers page 2's and backwards answers page 0's.  A search before it changes nothing
